title: टिकट आख़िरी बस की ख़ाली सीट पर कौन रख गया? 🎫
hook: ख़ाली बस की सीट पर कटा टिकट पड़ा था।

beats.text: ख़ाली बस की सीट पर कटा टिकट पड़ा था।
beats.scene: Top-down macro view looking straight down at one small rectangular paper bus ticket lying completely flat on a cracked green vinyl bus seat. The perforated cream ticket reverse is blank and unprinted. The camera is very close, so this small flat ticket occupies half the image. Green seat texture fills every edge; a warm ceiling-bulb reflection and a cool blue window reflection softly cross the vinyl. Inside the parked depot bus. No people or hands.

beats.text: उन्नीस सौ छियानवे, उस रात टीन की छत वाले बस अड्डे पर सन्नाटा पसरा था।
beats.scene: Prabhat in his mustard sweater and Shailesh in his red cricket cap walk alongside the row of silent parked buses at the tin-roof bus depot. The warm amber beam of an oil lantern at the distant tea stall cuts against cool midnight blue shadows.

beats.text: शैलेश हँसते हुए उसी सीट पर जा बैठा, और बस की पीली बत्ती अपने-आप जल उठी।
beats.scene: Inside the bus at the tin-roof bus depot, Shailesh sits down casually on the window seat beside the ticket. Suddenly, an overhead yellow bulb flickers to life directly above him, cutting through the heavy blue gloom of the parked vehicle.

beats.text: झब्बू काका ने लाठी ठटकाई कि रात की सीट किसी की होती है, बिना किराया दिए नहीं उठ सकते।
beats.scene: At the entrance of the bus at the tin-roof bus depot, Jhabbu stands in his khaki kurta and red muffler, resting his bamboo stick firmly on the floor while holding his brass lantern. Prabhat stands behind him, glancing anxiously down the aisle.

beats.text: शैलेश ने आँखें झुकाकर माना कि वो दर्जनों बार बिना टिकट शहर भागा था।
beats.scene: Inside the bus at the tin-roof bus depot, Shailesh remains frozen on the seat with his transistor clutched against his chest. His head is lowered under the dim yellow ceiling bulb, while blue moonlight edges his shoulders.

beats.text: उसने डरते हुए समोसे वाले चार रुपये कंडक्टर की लोहे की पेटी में डाल दिए।
beats.scene: Near the front door inside the bus at the tin-roof bus depot, Shailesh carefully drops metal coins into a metal conductor cash box mounted on the pipe. The flickering yellow dome light casts long blue shadows along the empty aisle.

beats.text: बत्ती बुझ गई, और झब्बू काका ने लाल रजिस्टर में लिख दिया कि पुराना हिसाब बराबर हुआ।
beats.scene: At the wooden counter of the tea stall beside the tin-roof bus depot, Jhabbu rests his brass lantern and marks an entry into his red-bound register with a short pencil. Prabhat watches from the side in the tranquil moonlit blue night.

cast.name: झब्बू

cast.look: sturdy eighteen-year-old young man with adult proportions, faded red cricket cap, striped shirt, a small transistor radio in a brown leather case on a shoulder strap, blue rubber flip-flops, seen from behind

description: बस अड्डे पर खड़ी आख़िरी बस की सीट पर पहले से कटा टिकट रखा था। शैलेश मज़ाक में उस सीट पर जा बैठा और अचानक बस की बत्ती जल उठी।
